build_get_delta_lake_table: build a Delta Lake table from a URI path with optional version, storage options, and delta table options
resolve_delta_lake_uri: resolve a Delta Lake URI path to an absolute string path handling local and remote schemes
check_if_delta_available: check if the deltalake Python package is installed and raise an error if missing
check_for_unsupported_types: check a list of Polars data types and raise TypeError if Time or Null types are present
extract_table_statistics: extract table statistics including record counts, null counts, min and max values from Delta add actions
